passages.quote:
Securing the safety of school premises

Subject Details

Controlling access to school premises Controlling access to school premises helps schools understand what they should do to remove someone who is on the premises without permission

Meeting health and safety responsibilities and duties Health and safety: advice for schools covers performing risk assessments to identify measures to control during school activities

Maintaining school security School and college security helps schools manage security effectively and put in place sensible and proportionate policies and plans. It providing practical, non-statutory guidance and highlights relevant legislation

Improving behaviour Behaviour in schools provides guidance for headteachers and school staff on developing a behaviour policy

Preventing and managing violent incidents Preparing for, preventing, and managing incidents involving online and offline violence provides advice and resources

Online safety templates School online safety policy templates provides a range of policy templates, including on ‘acceptable use’

Preventing bullying

Subject Details

Preventing and responding to bullying Preventing bullying provides guidance for headteachers, school staff, parents and carers on bullying and cyber bullying. It covers the obligations and powers schools have to tackle peer-to-peer bullying, and the principles that underpin the most effective anti-bullying strategies in schools

Preventing and responding to cyber bullying Cyberbullying guidance helps schools understand, prevent and respond to cyber bullying

Reporting incidents

Subject Details

Reporting stalking and harassment What to do now if you’re being stalked or harassed defines stalking and harassment, provides information on how to report it and the support that is available to victims

Reporting online harassment I’m being harassed by someone on social media. What can I do? covers how to report online harassment, malicious messaging or distribution of private sexual images without consent

Supporting staff

Subject Details

Supporting staff Education Support is a charity that offers advice and support on bullying and harassment of teachers and education staff

Workplace bullying helpline The National Bullying Helpline can advise employees affected by bullying in the workplace

Supporting professionals working with children The Professionals Online Safety Helpline provides advice for schools, public bodies and industry on appropriate actions to take in regard to safeguarding and advancing positive online safety policies

Social media mediation The Professionals Online Safety Helpline provides signposting to, advice on, and mediation with social media platforms to resolve any online safety issues faced by school staff

Responding to serious events Critical incidents in educational communities provides resources to help educational communities deliver a comprehensive and compassionate response to traumatic events

Online Safety

Subject Details

Filtering and monitoring online content Meeting digital and technology standards in schools and colleges - filtering and monitoring provides guidance for schools and colleges on how to filter and monitor harmful online content

Preventing extremism Educate Against Hate – Prevent radicalisation and extremism provides advice on safeguarding students from radicalisation and includes classroom resources and discussion points for teachers, parents and school leaders

Keeping children safe online Online safety resources from the NSPCC include training courses and advice to improve professional practice and keep children safe online

Engaging parents and carers

Subject Details

Setting up parental controls Keep children safe online: Information, advice, support provides a range of resources for parents and professionals to help set up parental controls and protect children from deepfakes

Engaging parents with relationships education Engaging parents with relationships education policy provides guidance to primary headteachers

Engaging parents with online activity Resources for parents provides support and resources for schools to help engage parents in their children’s online activity

Engaging parents positively Guidance on positive parental engagement in schools provides strategies to help engage and build trust with parents and involve them in their child’s education

Increasing online safety Guidance and resources for parents and carers about online safety helps parents support their children in staying safe online

Upskilling parents Parent Zone provides a range of tools and resources to help parents and teachers understand the online resources children may use

Managing parental complaints Parentkind’s parent guide to school complaints can be shared with parents

Preventing filming at school No filming at this school explains why filming around school premises should be avoided. Parents and visitors can be directed to this resource

Workload and wellbeing

Subject Details

Workload and wellbeing service Improve workload and wellbeing for school staff is a service produced by school leaders for school leaders that hosts free resources, including a workload reduction toolkit and case studies

Employment and professional conduct

Subject Details

Teacher misconduct Teacher misconduct: the prohibition of teachers explains how serious teacher misconduct is considered and when a teacher may be prohibited from teaching

Staffing and employment advice for schools Staffing and employment guidance for schools provides advice for schools on managing staff and meeting employment responsibilities

Equality and human rights The Equality Advisory and Support Service provides information, advice and support to individuals on issues related to equality and human rights

Dispute resolution Dispute resolution provides guidance on resolving workplace disagreements and disputes between employers and employees
